_note: I034d: PC annotate actor batch grass_valley, files 6-11 of 15: the enemies of the Underground Castle, Leo's Paintings and the unplaced green humanoid, the Metal Mantis boss and the unreferenced 'I am dreaming' string. Names applied first by renames/apply-I034d_names.json. Enemy identities come from the lair record type byte (+$15 of LairRecords, see WorldMetaPointers), the walkthrough bestiary stats and the lair texts of the walkthrough (OQ-I034-10); behaviours are static readings of the scripts.

blockNote: The Green Humanoid (meta type $20 of world 0, 3 HP and 1 EXP in MetaGrassValley; the walkthrough bestiary lists 3 HP, 1 EXP, 'running into you') (file offset 1026633-1026703, bank 1F).
=== ROLE ===

A walker without an attack: it turns towards the hero (sideways with animation $05 and a flip bit, up $04, down $03) and runs into him. It is spawned by lair records whose type byte (+$15) is $20, for example the Underground Castle lairs of the walkthrough ('the Green Humanoids spawned by the monster lair').
=== NOTES ===
- Type $20 has no placement row in any Grass Valley scene; it only comes from lair records.

partNotes.gv_enemy_green_humanoid_0FAA49:
The Green Humanoid.

When: meta type $20; spawned by a lair (RunLairRespawn / SpawnAll), runs every frame.
Sees: a green humanoid that follows the hero; waits 8 frames while off screen.
Why: the simplest chaser of the world: COP 9A compares the X distance to the hero with $10, COP 9B the Y distance.
In: actor script, X = own slot.
Out: first a sideways step (animation $05, flip cleared or set by COP 97 / 96) when the hero is left or right, then a vertical one ($04 above, $03 below), then back to the start.
Clobbers: A.

blockNote: The enemies of the Underground Castle that have their own code (file offsets 1026703-1027370, bank 1F): the Yellow Humanoid ($21) with its three spheres, the Walking Bush ($22), the Fly ($23), the Blue Liquid ($24) and the Blue Torch ($25) with its fireball. The Green Humanoid ($20) is in gv_enemy_0FAA49.
=== ROSTER ===

Stats are the MetaGrassValley row (HP, BCD EXP) and the walkthrough bestiary agrees: Yellow Humanoid 4 HP / 2 EXP ('running into you, spheres'); Walking Bush, Fly and Blue Liquid 3 HP / 1 EXP; Blue Torch 5 HP / 2 EXP ('fireballs'). The type is the byte +$15 of a lair record (LairRecords): for example record $30 / $31 (Underground Castle east) has type $22 and the walkthrough says 'defeat the Walking Bushes coming from the nearby monster lair'; records $0F and $12 have type $23 and the walkthrough says 'Flies spawned by the monster lair'. The Blue Liquids ($24) and Blue Torches ($25) are placed in A02S01 and A02S02 directly (placement rows). The identity of $22 / $23 / $24 follows from these lairs and the placement, not from the sprites (OQ-I034-10).
=== NOTES ===
- All five start with the same guard: while the actor is off screen ($16 bit $8000) it waits a few frames with COP 1B.

Why: COP 9A / 9B pick the direction (left, within, right; above, within, below); each throw spawns one of the sphere actors with COP 85.
In: actor script, X = own slot.
Out: spheres gv_enemy_humanoid_sphere_0FAB61 (hero above), _0FAB6C (below), _0FAB4B (left or right, flipped by COP 96).
Clobbers: A.

In: actor script, X = own slot; the spawner sets the position.
Out: starts at offset (-1, +2) with animation $25 (the parent's flip bit gives the side; a second entry loc_0FAB56 with (+1, +2) is not referenced), repeats the flight animation $0C times, plays animation $24 and ends with COP 86; BRK $5B at the start.

blockNote: The enemies of Leo's Paintings (file offsets 1027370-1028341, bank 1F): the Yellow Knight ($26) with three spear actors, the Metal Crawler ($27), the Purple Bird ($28), the Green Torch ($29) with its fireball, the Monster Blocks ($2E) and the spikes ($2F).
=== ROSTER ===

Stats from MetaGrassValley and the walkthrough bestiary: Yellow Knight 9 HP / 5 EXP ('throwing spears'), Metal Crawler 24 HP / 250 EXP ('running around', metal), Purple Bird 4 HP / 3 EXP, Green Torch 9 HP / 4 EXP ('fireballs'), Monster Blocks 4 HP ('jumping at you'), spikes 1 HP / 0 EXP. The lair records give the identities: record $22 (type $28, the Purple Birds' lair that frees a tulip) and the walkthrough's 'Purple Birds' lair to release a tulip'. The Metal Crawlers need the Zantetsu Sword (walkthrough). The spikes are placed four times in A03S02 (the walkthrough: 'stone, non-moving paths (unless you some spike fetish)').
=== NOTES ===
- DISCREPANCY: MetaGrassValley type $2E gives the Monster Blocks 3 EXP, the walkthrough bestiary 2 EXP (OQ-I034-11). The $2E identity itself comes from the jump-at-you behaviour.
- Type $2F as 'spikes' rests on the placements and the walkthrough sentence above, not on a name in the ROM (OQ-I034-10).

blockNote: The Metal Mantis, the boss of Leo's Paintings (file offsets 12717-13254, bank 00): the mantis itself (meta type $1F, 50 HP, 50 EXP in MetaGrassValley; the walkthrough: 'Maximum HP: 50 HP, EXP. Earned: 50 EXP.') and its projectiles.
=== ROLE ===

The boss lair is record $09 (RunLairFormation, one monster of type $1F; home location 04, the Chief's room). The script starts the fight (boss_fight_active + 1, boss_actor = X, exit_list_ofs = 0) and spawns engine_003005.RunBossMapPatch with patch id 0 (it blocks the pad while the map changes). Defeating it sets switch $09, which frees the village Chief (gv_village_actors_019475) and changes the village dialogue.
=== ATTACKS (static reading, OQ-I034-12) ===

The walkthrough: 'Three fireballs fired simultaneously usually when you're far off', 'Arm attack if you're close', and the boss 'turns silvery' (immune) when the hero is on the far side of the field. In the script the hero's Y is tested against $70: at $70 or more the mantis is in its fire mode: three fireballs at once (gv_boss_mantis_fireball_003348 / _003359 / _003367, each spawned with COP B2 at offset (+8, -$18)) or two shots from its sides (gv_boss_mantis_shot_00337F, _003394); below $70 it uses the arm attack (gv_boss_mantis_arm_strike_0033B9 with gv_boss_mantis_arm_0033A9 on the left or _0033B1 on the right, while $16 bit $0002 is set). The silver phase is not visible in the script as a separate state (OQ-I034-12).
=== NOTES ===
- The boss is placed in the paintings scene A03S06 through its lair, not through a placement row.

partNotes.gv_boss_metal_mantis_0031AD:
The Metal Mantis.

When: meta type $1F; spawned by lair record $09 in A03S06 (the Metal Mantis room, location $0C).
Sees: 'a boss that only the sword hurts' (the walkthrough); its pose depends on where the hero stands.
Why: the script sets up the fight and then loops forever; COP 9A / 9B and the hero's Y choose between firing and arm attacks.
In: actor script, X = the boss slot.
Out: exit_list_ofs = 0, boss_fight_active += 1, boss_actor = X; RunBossMapPatch is spawned with patch id 0 in its $30; then the behaviour loops; COP 9F shifts the actor's X by +$10 before the distance tests and by -$10 in each branch, so the tests are taken from a point $10 right of its X.
Clobbers: A, Y.
